== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English Decipher-era [[Collision!]] original and Decipher Errata articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata · PC Errata (omit missing). Do not transclude onto Unlimited, Japanese, Two-Player, foil, or (V). <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
